memberdef.argsstring: (const GraphId &graphId, const K &key, const IterData &iterData, const std::string &rootSection, const std::optional< Z3Predicate > &condition)
memberdef.name: addRows

para.verbatim:
embed:rst This class inherits from :cpp:class:`BaseIniGraphGroupEdit` Collects the `KVPs`_ of some keys from :cpp:class:`IniSectionGraph`\ s, editing nothing :raw-html:`
` :raw-html:`
` For each graph named in \ref keys or \ref keyMatches, every :cpp:class:`IfContentPart` the graph reaches (through ``run =``, depth first) is searched for each key, and every occurrence is recorded as a \ref Row: where it is, its value, and optionally * \ref contextKeys: what other keys hold at that point, as the part's :cpp:class:`IfContentPartColouring` tracks them along the walk -- a key's occurrences in the part with their lines, or else the value it carries in from earlier on the same path (a caller before its ``run =``, or an earlier part). A key the part sets replaces the value carried in, and a value set on a sibling ``if`` branch is never carried * \ref withConditions: the condition of the ``if`` blocks the part sits in :raw-html:`
` The rows stay until the next \ref edit or \ref clear. Run as one of :cpp:member:`GIMIParser::commandEdits`, a collect with a \ref name files its rows in the parser's :cpp:class:`IniParseData` (:cpp:func:`IniParseData::collected`) -- see :cpp:class:`IParseResult` .. warning:: The rows are a snapshot of the graphs as they were when the collect ran, and nothing keeps them up to date. An edit run afterwards that renames, copies, moves or removes a section, or changes a value, leaves every row it touched describing what is no longer there -- and such a row still reads like a good one. Read the rows before any edit that changes the graphs they came from, or run the collect again

parameterdescription.para: The type of the keys stored in a referenced :cpp:class:IfContentPart
The type of the values stored in a referenced :cpp:class:IfContentPart
A hasher for K. Defaults to std::hash<K>
An equality comparator for K. Defaults to std::equal_to<K>
